Then the response is 401 with MSG-P4-001 and nothing is written

  Scenario: AC13 A role without the right of the capability area is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the caller holds a Workbench role without the right of the capability area
    When the caller calls any operation of rwb-asset for the quality run of 2026-11-30
    Then the response is 403 with MSG-P4-002 and nothing is written

  Scenario: AC14 The provided operations answer 404 for a run that does not exist (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the caller holds a Workbench role with the Platform administration right R
    When the caller reads GET /quality-runs/{businessDate} for a business date with no quality run
    Then the response is 404 and nothing is written

  Scenario: AC15 An activity of the quality run is retried or times out (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a reconciliation activity of the quality run of 2026-11-30 times out and is retried
    When the retried activity completes
    Then no row is written twice for the same rec_code, quality_check and business_date
    Then the retry count and the timeout are Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-S5-E1011-APP-AC15)

  Scenario: AC16 A consumed call fails or does not answer (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-source-data contract mock does not answer the read of DP06 Collateral and assets for 2026-11-30
    When the quality run of 2026-11-30 runs
    Then the system writes no quality result for 2026-11-30 and the run state of 2026-11-30 is FAILED with the failing system named
    Then the system shows MSG-GEN-006 naming that system

  Scenario: AC17 A status change the model does not allow is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the run state of 2026-11-30 is RELEASED
    When a change of the run state that the state model does not allow is requested
    Then the change is refused, the run state of 2026-11-30 stays RELEASED and nothing is written
    Then the allowed transitions and the message of the refusal are Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-S5-E1011-APP-AC17)
